free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0 a month: 50 requests a day at up to 1 request a second, current weather and 7-day daily forecasts, 1 API key; no hourly, minutely or historical data.
free_tier.notes: The daily cap resets at 00:00 UTC and answers HTTP 429; X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset headers and a usage endpoint report the count. Bulk path: none on Free; Plus and Business add 5 and 30 years of history. Local storage of API data is stated for paid subscriptions. A free account with no login for 15 months is disabled.

retention.stated: not applicable: the unit is a request

interface_detail: REST over HTTPS at api.weatherbit.io/v2.0 with the key in the key query parameter; JSON answers
chaining: A small keyed current-weather and 7-day forecast source; 50 requests a day covers a few locations polled every few hours.

limits.value: 50 requests a day on Free, reset at 00:00 UTC

binding_note: 50 requests a day is met long before 1 request a second.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page offers Google or GitHub sign-in, or a form with username, password, repeated password and email, with no card or phone field; whether a card is asked after sign-up for the Free plan is unverified (the pricing page says no card for the 21 day Business trial).

reliability_note: 95% uptime is listed for Free; the daily cap answers HTTP 429 until 00:00 UTC, and an account unused for 15 months is disabled.
confidence_note: Plan limits and the sign-up form are read from first-party pages; a call with no key answered HTTP 403, so a keyed call was not exercised.
